explore.title: Earth Online
explore.subtitle: Zenly-style fog circles + timed regional events (??? until revealed).
explore.cultureHint: While in fog you only see ???; after the area is lit by your footprint circles, the event name appears.
explore.fogHint: From bottom to top: footprints clear fog and show the base map as-is (circle radius {{radius}} m); gray in countries you’ve entered but outside those circles; opaque fog where you’ve never set foot (no labels); same for oceans except inside circles. Activities on top.
explore.mapNavHint: Strategy zoom: World → continent → country/region (data: world-countries).
explore.syncMissing: Configure Supabase: set EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in mobile/.env, run database/migrations 002 & 003, restart Expo.
explore.syncHint: Use one sync code on multiple devices to share visit centers (player_fog.visited_points).
explore.coordsHint: Culture HUD uses this point; fog uses intersection with your circles.
explore.devJoystickHint: Press and drag on the pad to move and drop pins for fog; release to stop. Farther from center = faster. Starts near Taipei 101 if no position yet.
explore.demoRoutesHint: Demo routes: ~{{ms}} ms per pin. File imports auto-shorten spacing when there are many points. Loop: Hwy1 corridor + east coast. Flight: Taoyuan → Thailand (approx).
explore.devToolsBanner: This block shows only in Metro dev, if EXPO_PUBLIC_DEV_EXPLORE_TOOLS=1, or if the signed-in email is listed in EXPO_PUBLIC_DEV_TESTER_EMAILS. Keep off in production store builds.
explore.devToolsHiddenHint: Preset jumps, jitter, demo routes, Google / GeoJSON import, and “clear footprint centers” are for testing only; regular users do not see them. Ask your team if your account should be on the tester list or the internal build flag enabled.
explore.importHint: Google: use Takeout “Location History” JSON. Flights: GeoJSON with LineString or MultiLineString (large files are downsampled).
explore.importOkMsg: Loaded {{count}} coordinates and started simulated check-ins.
explore.importGoogleFail: Could not parse coordinates. Use Google Takeout Location History JSON.
explore.importGeoFail: Could not parse a route. Use GeoJSON with LineString or MultiLineString.
explore.clearPins: Clear footprint centers (writes empty to cloud)
explore.pinsEmpty: Pick a place or jitter to open fog
explore.alertCopiedMsg: Paste the code on another device, then tap Apply.
explore.alertSyncOkMsg: Loaded fog progress for this code.
explore.alertNewGameMsg: Creates a new code and clears local fog. Old cloud saves are not deleted.

playerProgress.title: Profile & progress
playerProgress.guestHint: Sign in to sync level, XP, and check-in stats. Achievements still use local fog circles below.
playerProgress.dbMissingHint: Level fields missing. Apply database/migrations/009_check_ins_xp.sql in Supabase (profiles xp_total/level, check_ins, etc.).

first_pin.title: First memory
first_pin.desc: Save at least one check-in to the cloud.

auth.title: Earth Online
auth.subtitle: Sign in for friends & voice wake-up.
auth.alertVerifyMsg: If confirmations are enabled, open the link in your inbox before signing in.
auth.usernameRule: Username must be 3–32 chars, lowercase letters, digits, underscore only.
auth.emailNotConfirmed: This email is not verified. In Supabase Dashboard → Authentication → Users, confirm “Email Confirmed”, or run npm run seed:admin with SERVICE_ROLE on your machine.
auth.invalidCreds: Wrong email/password, or user does not exist. Check admin@earthonline.test / seed password and run npm run seed:admin.

friends.title: Friends & voice
friends.webBanner: Web preview has no mic recording; use iOS / Android for voice wake-up.
friends.theyDenyVoice: They have not allowed you to send voice (ask them to enable)
friends.alertNoWebRecordMsg: Record voice on iOS / Android app.
friends.alertNoSendMsg: They have not enabled voice wake-up for you.
friends.voiceErrPermission: They have not allowed your voice wake-up. Ask them to enable it in friends list.
friends.voiceErrFriends: Only accepted friends can send voice wake-up.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Interface language. Region / country names on the map follow the locale when available.
settings.mapHint: Satellite is realistic imagery; other options are vector maps (roads / light / dark).

mapFallback.needToken: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN to preview the fog map.
